definitions.explanation: An unexpected and undesirable event, especially one causing damage or injury. Commonly refers to traffic accidents or industrial incidents.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{事故|じこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れています→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The train is delayed due to an accident.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{事故|じこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっています→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: There was a big accident, so the road is blocked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事故|じこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}{人|にん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}きました→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard that three people were taken to the hospital because of yesterday's accident.

notes:
{事故|じこ} refers to accidents, especially those causing damage or injury.

TYPES:
- ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧: traffic accident
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧{事故|じこ}: car accident
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧{事故|じこ}: plane crash
- ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧{事故|じこ}: workplace accident

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {事故|じこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to have an accident
- {事故|じこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause an accident
- {事故|じこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: to be delayed due to an accident
- ⟦{人身事故|じんしんじこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧: accident involving injury (often used in train announcements)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: incident, case (often implies crime or noteworthy event)
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: disaster (natural or large-scale)

{事故|じこ} implies unintentional harm, while ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ may involve deliberate action.
